_comment: Alt-C canned Azure detect output for the SECOND clip (best-goal, a distinct ~12s goal window of best-goals-2025-30s.mov). FakeAzureVision(objects=...) returns these same objects for EVERY sampled frame, so the precompute derive writes a detect entry at every sampled ts in the manifest window (11000-13000ms @ 8fps). Posture mirrors fake_detect_4625.json: deliberately NOT in det_id/confidence order (so minting is exercised), and a `ball` is present to verify class filtering. The conf-0.71 left box is the scorer the manifest pin renames to p_seven and reads as #7.
